card.name: Zero in toxicity grade ranges
card.fires_on: The digit 0 right after "Grade" in dose-resume rules such as "improved to Grade 0 or 1". It also fires weakly on other zero-like or journal-title words in citations.

modes.label: Grade 0 in resume rules
modes.description: The digit 0 as the lower end of a grade range, after "to Grade" or "to grade".
modes.example: Interrupt sorafenib tablets until resolved or improved to Grade <<0>> to 1. Interrupt sorafenib

modes.label: Journal title words in citations
modes.description: The end of a journal name in a reference line, such as biology or the initial J.
modes.example: Citation: J Cell Biol. 1983 Sep;97(3):902-8. The Journal of cell<< biology>>
